blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Even before September arrives, signs of Christmas begin appearing in the Philippines, with malls decked out in glittering lights and holiday decorations and homes taking on a festive glow. In places such as Dapitan and Divisoria in Metro Manila, Christmas comes even earlier, with stalls overflowing with ornaments, gifts and other holiday wares. For Filipinos, Christmas does not wait for December. It arrives months ahead, woven into the sights, sounds and preparations of everyday life. The early start reflects the cooler “ber” months, Filipino culture’s emphasis on children and family, and the practical value of having more time […]...
